notes: 防具マスターを追加。使用32種類中20種類を公開データで外部照合。verified/mhdb_verifiedは未変更。
v7: synchronized user-confirmed charm decorations and Bow weapon decorations with simulator v7.1.4; 3-slot charm reflection uses weaponSlots + armor slots. Free slots remain unresolved by design.

v8: simulator BUILD_TEMPLATE_DB (v2.0) is the canonical source-consumed representation. User-confirmed charm free slots and bow weapon decorations are synchronized; synchronization does not imply MHDB verification.

2026-09-30: Applied user-revised complete 14 Kotatsu builds. Charm slots are represented only as actual slot levels: [1,1,1] for 栄世, [2,1] for 史伝/秘歴; no [3][-][-] charm pattern. Obvious transcription variants were normalized to canonical weapon/armor names for DB matching (e.g. 亡国のクピドバイン, 荊冠のデストレーター, 闇黒のテルプリティカ, 護児爪竜).
v14: 14 こたつ氏ビルドの装飾品必要スロットLvを装飾品マスター基準で正規化。特に痛撃/挑戦/連撃/刺撃/反攻=3、逆襲/渾身/無傷/防音=2、速納/持続=1、守勢・鉄壁=3。ヘビィ護石は攻1防1、射法珠+速納珠。
